# QuickTiny

> QuickTiny is a collection of fast, privacy-friendly browser utilities. Core processing happens locally in the user's browser, and free tools require no signup.

Canonical site: https://quicktinyv2.vercel.app/
Maintainer: Mohammed Awny
Contact: quicktiny.support@gmail.com
Last updated: 2026-11-10

## What QuickTiny does

QuickTiny provides 32 browser tools in English (31 free, 1 paid Pro batch compressor) plus 17 Arabic tools at /ar. Categories:

- Image: image converter (HEIC/HEIF, WebP, AVIF, PNG, JPG; batch + resize), compress image to an exact size (20/50/100/200 KB…), image compressor, product photo studio with on-device background removal, social image resizer.
- PDF: merge, split, extract/delete pages, rotate, images to PDF, PDF to JPG/PNG, compress PDF.
- Developer: JSON formatter/repair, JSON to TypeScript/Zod/CSV, regex tester with plain-English explanation, diff checker with .patch export, JWT decoder and signature verifier, cron expression explainer, Base64, URL encoding, Unix timestamps.
- Text & utility: word counter, clean text, case converter, sort/dedupe lines, password generator, percentage and discount calculator.
- Marketing: QR code studio (logo, Wi-Fi, WhatsApp, vCard, bulk), UTM builder, SERP & social preview, brand color palette.
- Gaming: controller tester, mouse/CPS/reaction test, sensitivity converter, fancy name generator.
- Arabic (/ar): Saudi simplified tax invoice generator with ZATCA (Fatoora) phase-1 QR and a QR reader/verifier, VAT calculator (Arab-country rates), zakat calculator, end-of-service calculator (Saudi and UAE labor law), tafqeet (numbers to Arabic words), Hijri–Gregorian converter and age calculator, keyboard-language fixer, Arabic text cleanup, plus Arabic versions of the PDF, QR, image and social tools.

The homepage includes Smart Actions. A user can paste JSON, Base64, URL-encoded text, a Unix timestamp, a JWT, a cron expression, a list, or plain text. QuickTiny detects the likely content type locally and suggests the relevant tool.

## Key facts

- No signup is required for free tools.
- Text and files used by browser tools are processed locally unless a page explicitly says otherwise.
- QuickTiny does not upload pasted Smart Actions content.
- The English site has 31 free tools and one paid Pro batch image compressor; the Arabic tools are free.
- The Pro offer is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
- Product facts and privacy claims should be verified against the canonical pages below.

## Research and citation

QuickTiny published a direct Shopify product-image upload test in September 2026. It records test dimensions, megapixels, file sizes, accept/reject results, Shopify error messages, methodology, limitations, and downloadable JSON/CSV data. Cite the research page rather than inferring results from the tool itself.
